outline.title: How a sine wave works
outline.summary: A sine wave is smooth, repeating up-and-down motion. This lesson builds intuition for its two knobs: amplitude (height) and frequency (how many cycles fit across).

beats.intent: Introduce a sine wave as smooth, repeating up-and-down motion.

narration.text: A sine wave is the smoothest way something can go up and down and repeat forever. Watch it roll across the screen.

beats.intent: Show that amplitude controls the height of the wave.

narration.text: Amplitude is how tall the wave is. Drag the slider and the peaks grow or shrink — but the timing stays the same.

beats.intent: Show that frequency controls how many cycles fit across the screen.

narration.text: Frequency is how many full cycles fit across. Turn it up and the wave bunches together; turn it down and it stretches out.
